blocks.title: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
blocks.text: PaaS offers a complete development and deployment environment in the cloud: infrastructure, middleware, development tools and management services, so developers focus on coding without managing hardware and software layers.
Google App Engine lets developers build and deploy applications in many programming languages; Microsoft Azure App Services and Heroku are other examples.
